meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: Socialist Republic of Viet Nam (Cong hoa Xa hoi Chu nghia Viet Nam)
meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Viet Nam (unitary national jurisdiction; recommended registration seat: Hanoi DPI or Ho Chi Minh City DPI; no sub-state corporate law distinction; foreign-invested LLC registered at provincial Department of Planning and Investment)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (socialist-law family with French civilist heritage; codified under Law on Enterprises 2020 and Law on Investment 2020; no common-law stare decisis authority)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Prevention and Combating Money Laundering No. 09/2022/QH15 (approved 15 November 2022; effective 1 March 2023); Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP dated 28 April 2023 (AML implementing decree); State Bank of Vietnam Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN (reporting forms) and Circular No. 29/2023/TT-NHNN (internal control and enhanced due diligence); Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 Articles 28, 47-49 (member register, charter, capital contribution); Law on Credit Institutions No. 47/2010/QH12 as amended
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (UBO declarations and AML/CFT reports accessible to the State Bank of Vietnam, the Anti-Money Laundering Division/FIU, and licensed financial institutions; natural-person members of an LLC are disclosed in the public business registry at DPI level as members, but indirect beneficial ownership is not publicly searchable)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport of each proposed individual shareholder and the nominated legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority and notary public in country of origin (or Vietnamese Embassy where fingerprints are verified)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Convention in force for Viet Nam since 27 July 2020); for issuers non-signatory to the 1961 Convention: Vietnamese Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of the direct corporate shareholder (parent entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry / Registrar of Companies of the parent jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Vietnamese Consular Legalization, followed by certified Vietnamese translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original board resolution (or equivalent corporate consent) approving establishment of the Viet Nam LLC, capital contribution amount, and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors / corporate secretary of the parent entity, notarized at the parent's seat
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Vietnamese Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank letter evidencing availability of the foreign investment capital (bank statement or letter of comfort, latest 6 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Primary relationship bank of the investor in the jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank-certified copy plus Hague Apostille or Vietnamese consular seal; Vietnamese translation notarized locally

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Chapter III, Section 2, Articles 22–31 on enterprise registration and the Certificate of Enterprise Registration; Chapter IV, Articles 46–50 on capital contribution obligations and legal representatives of limited liability companies); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Chapter III, Articles 37–40 on investment registration procedures and the Investment Registration Certificate); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration; Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP detailing the Law on Investment; Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHDT on enterprise registration forms; Circular No. 03/2021/TT-BKHDT on investment registration forms.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or centrally administered city where the LLC is headquartered; Enterprise Registration Division acting through the National Business Registration Portal (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) and the National Foreign Investment Information System.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form prescribed by Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHDT) resulting in issuance of the Certificate of Enterprise Registration; for foreign-invested enterprises, preceded by the Application for Investment Registration under Circular No. 03/2021/TT-BKHDT resulting in the Investment Registration Certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up charter capital applies to a foreign-invested LLC providing offshore engineering CAD/BIM services under the Law on Enterprises 2020. The charter capital stated in the Company Charter must be fully paid in by all members within 90 days from the date of issuance of the Certificate of Enterprise Registration. No escrowed account is mandatorily required by law; however, capital contributions from foreign investors must be channelled into the company's Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) opened with a licensed commercial bank in Vietnam. Practical substance and administrative discretion favour a charter capital sufficient to sustain payroll, office lease, and bank transfer operations for the offshore service model.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDING MEMBERS OF [VIETNAM ENGINEERING SERVICES CO., LTD.] (A FOREIGN-INVESTED LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY)

WE, the undersigned Founding Members / Members' Council of [VIETNAM ENGINEERING SERVICES CO., LTD.] (Company), having jointly prepared and ratified the Company Charter for incorporation in the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam, hereby adopt this First Members' Resolution on [DD/MM/YYYY] as follows:

WHEREAS the Company intends to carry on the business of offshore Building Information Modeling (BIM), structural drafting, and civil infrastructure engineering services in accordance with ISIC 7110 and the Investment Registration Certificate to be issued by the provincial Department of Planning and Investment; and

WHEREAS the Company lawfully requires an investment vehicle in Viet Nam and the appointment of officers and the adoption of a registered office to complete statutory incorporation.

IT IS RESOLVED UNANIMOUSLY AS FOLLOWS:

1. SHARE / CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION

The charter capital of the Company is hereby fixed at VND [●] (in words: [●] Vietnamese Dong, approximately USD [●]), consisting of the separate capital contributions of the Founding Members as set out in the List of Members attached to the application for enterprise registration. Each Founding Member hereby subscribes to their respective capital contribution. The Chairman of the Members' Council and the General Director are jointly and severally directed to open a bank account or accounts in the Company's name, including a Direct Investment Capital Account where required for foreign investors, and to procure payment of all subscribed capital within 90 days of the Certificate of Enterprise Registration. No capital contribution may be withdrawn or repaid except as permitted by the Law on Enterprises 2020.

2. ADOPTION OF REGISTERED OFFICE

The members hereby adopt as the Company's registered office and full legal domicile in Viet Nam the address: [●], [●] Ward, [●] District, [●] Province/City, Viet Nam. The registered office shall be the place of service of legal process, tax notices, and official correspondence. The General Director is authorised to execute the office lease agreement, obtain the lessor's written consent or certificate of premises use, and file all registration documents with the Department of Planning and Investment and relevant authorities.

3. APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS AND LEGAL REPRESENTATIVE

The following officers are hereby appointed with effect from the date of this Resolution:

a) [Name of Member #1] is appointed Chairman of the Members' Council, with authority to convene meetings, coordinate corporate governance, and supervise legal and compliance matters.

b) [Name of Individual] is appointed General Director of the Company and shall be the legal representative of the Company under the Law on Enterprises 2020. The General Director shall have day-to-day management authority and power to negotiate, execute and deliver contracts, open and operate bank accounts, sign tax declarations, e-invoices, employment agreements, and any other documents necessary for the Company's operations, within the scope of the Company Charter and applicable law.

c) [Name of Individual] is appointed Chief Financial Officer and Accounting Officer / Chief Accountant, with authority over accounting books, tax filings, payroll, and bank compliance procedures.

d) [Name of Individual] is appointed as Compliance Officer for corporate registration, licensing, and environmental, health and safety matters.

4. GENERAL AUTHORISATION

Any one of the Chairman, General Director, or Chief Financial Officer, acting singly, is authorised to sign and submit to the Department of Planning and Investment, the tax authority, banks, and any other governmental bodies all applications, declarations, and instruments necessary to complete the incorporation and post-incorporation steps described in this resolution, including the opening of bank accounts, the sealing of the Company, and the registration of e-invoices.

This Resolution is effective immediately upon its signing by all Founding Members and shall remain in full force until revoked or replaced by a subsequent members' resolution.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned have executed this Resolution as their act and deed on the date first written above.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Investment Registration Certificate for Foreign-Invested Entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI); one-stop Investment Registration Division; online intake through the National Foreign Investment Information System or direct submission at DPI office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and submit the investment registration dossier in Vietnamese, with English translations where requested. Legalise and notarise passport copies or corporate constitutional documents of the foreign investor, certified bank financial capacity documents, and the power of attorney in favour of the local project representative. Include a formal investment project proposal describing the offshore engineering CAD/BIM services model, anticipated charter capital, staffing, office location, and annual sales forecast. For pure offshore services no conditional market access obligation arises under the Law on Investment Annex I; the DPI will issue the Investment Registration Certificate within 15 working days of a complete dossier. After approval, print the IRC and preserve it for the enterprise registration step.
required_dossiers: Application for Investment Registration (Form prescribed by Circular No. 03/2021/TT-BKHDT)
Investment project proposal containing economic, technical, and environmental justification
Valid passport or incorporation certificate of the investing entity, legalised and notarised
Financial capacity statement of the investor certified by a bank (unimpeded transferability)
Power of attorney appointing the local dossier submission representative
Proposed charter capital breakdown and capital contribution schedule
Statement confirming that no environmentally hazardous production processes are involved (office-based services)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a written request for additional information (normally within 5 working days of receipt), the applicant must cure the deficiency within 15 working days; failure to do so results in return of the dossier, which may be immediately resubmitted as a new filing without prejudice. If the DPI refuses to issue the IRC, the applicant may (1) amend and resubmit the investment proposal, or (2) lodge an administrative complaint with the Chairman of the Provincial People's Committee within 30 days of the refusal, or initiate judicial review under the Law on Administrative Procedures at the competent administrative court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for Certificate of Enterprise Registration and Ratification of Company Charter
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Enterprise Registration Division of the Provincial Department of Planning and Investment; National Business Registration Portal (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following issuance of the IRC, convene and sign the Vietnamese Company Charter and the First Members' Resolution. Log onto the National Business Registration Portal using the legal representative's one-time registration or the authorised law firm's digital signature (PKI). Complete the Application for Enterprise Registration with the Company name, registered office address, business lines (ISIC 7110 – engineering CAD/BIM services), charter capital, members' list, legal representatives, and the IRC reference. Upload the charter, member list, lease agreement, and notarised identity documents. Pay the VND one hundred thousand (approx. USD 4.00) state enterprise registration fee via the portal's online payment gateway. The DPI will issue the Certificate of Enterprise Registration within 3 working days if the dossier is complete and compliant.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form prescribed by Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHDT)
Vietnam Company Charter ratified by all Founding Members
Valid Investment Registration Certificate issued by the DPI
List of Founding Members and their capital contribution percentages
Notarised copies of passports / national ID cards of members and the legal representative
Registered office lease agreement or written consent of the premises owner for use of the address
Power of attorney or authorisation for any filing agent or law firm
Digital signature certificate of the legal representative for portal submission
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The registry must notify the applicant of any missing or irregular document within 3 working days and provide a deadline not exceeding 10 working days to correct. If the application is rejected or suspended, the applicant may submit a new folder through the portal with the precise rectification indicated in the rejection notice. Where the rejection is alleged to be arbitrary, the company may file an administrative appeal to the Director of the DPI within 30 days, and thereafter to the Provincial People's Committee or competent administrative court, while continuing preparatory steps in parallel.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Seal / Chop Engraving and Publication of Company Information
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (publication verification) and licensed seal engraving enterprise; company self-management of seal under the Law on Enterprises 2020
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the ERC, instruct a licensed Vietnamese seal engraving enterprise to produce the corporate seal/chop in accordance with the required format (company full registered name, tax code, and regional script). No prior governmental approval is required for the seal design under the Law on Enterprises 2020, but the seal specimen must be preserved for use before banks and state authorities. File the company's public information notice on the National Business Registration Portal to confirm the completed registration; the DPI will publish the information automatically. Register a digital signature (e-Cert) for the legal representative and, if needed, the seal specimen on the official portal to enable future electronic transactions with the tax authority and social insurance.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Enterprise Registration (copy)
Investment Registration Certificate (copy)
Legal representative's citizen identification card or passport
Chop engraving service order and specimen form from the seal engraving enterprise
Proof of payment of the enterprise registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the portal rejects the seal publication for image quality or format, re-upload a high-resolution scanned ERC and the seal specimen in PDF and resubmit. If a bank or notary refuses the seal stamp, obtain a confirmation record from the seal engraving enterprise and re-register the seal specimen; no administrative complaint to DPI is necessary because seal registration is declaratory rather than licensing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Code Confirmation, Bank Account Opening, and e-Invoice Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT) via the local Tax Department / Tax Sub-Department; State Bank of Viet Nam licensed commercial banks (for Direct Investment Capital Account); central e-invoice system under Decree No. 123/2020/ND-CP
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon issuance of the ERC, the tax identification number (TIN) is automatically generated by the National Business Registration Portal and transferred electronically to the local Tax Sub-Department; verify the TIN through the GDT's e-service website. Open a company bank account and a Direct Investment Capital Account to receive inbound foreign capital contributions and offshore service payments. Submit to the bank the ERC, IRC, charter, seal specimen, and signed Members' Resolution appointing signatories. After receiving the bank account details, log onto the GDT e-invoice portal to apply for supplier profile verification and issue electronic invoices in accordance with Decree 123/2020/ND-CP; the application is completed when the tax authority certifies the company as an e-invoice issuer. Also register the employer with the Social Insurance Agency and labour authority if hiring local staff.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Enterprise Registration and Investment Registration Certificate
First Members' Resolution appointing banking signatories
Company Charter and seal specimen
Lease contract for the registered office demonstrating physical presence
Legal representative's identity documentation
E-invoice registration application (Form prescribed by Decree 123/2020/ND-CP)
Direct Investment Capital Account registration form (bank-specific)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank declines to open the Direct Investment Capital Account, present a written refusal and approach another licensed commercial bank; the State Bank of Viet Nam does not mandate any specific bank and refusal by one bank is not a statutory barrier. If the tax authority rejects or does not act on the e-invoice registration, submit a written complaint to the local Tax Department Director and, if necessary, to the General Department of Taxation within 30 days. If the TIN is not visible in the tax portal within 5 working days of the ERC, request an urgent correction via the national business registration hotline or the tax authority counter.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for the registered scope — ISIC 7110 engineering CAD/BIM/structural drafting is an office-based, non-manufacturing service activity and requires no industrial manufacturing permit. If the company later expands into domestic construction survey, design or supervision work in Vietnam, the Ministry of Construction (MoC) and provincial Construction Departments would have jurisdiction under Decree No. 15/2021/ND-CP and civil engineering firm capacity certification regimes; such a licence is expressly not triggered by the current offshore service model.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required under the offshore engineering service scope. The company should, however, obtain and maintain voluntary industrial good-standing documents where commercially requested by foreign clients; it may also elect to obtain ISO 9001:2015 certification for engineering drafting quality, though this is non-statutory. No 'operating permit' under Vietnamese industrial law is required because no goods are manufactured, processed or exported.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Viet Nam Environment Administration (VEA) of the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment; provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) exercises jurisdiction where registration or verification is potentially sought — however, the project is exempt.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category VII, Part II of Annex II to Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP (office-based services and engineering consulting projects not involving production or physical infrastructure construction) are excluded from environmental impact assessment and from environmental registration obligations. No Environmental Impact Assessment report and no Environmental Registration Certificate is required solely for the offshore BIM/CAD office activity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharge thresholds apply because no wastewater is generated from production processes. The office lease must respect general municipal solid waste collection obligations, and the premises must comply with workplace environmental quality norms including QCVN 27:2010/BTNMT (noise limits in workplaces) and QCVN 26:2016/BTNMT (ambient noise limits). If backup generators or HVAC cooling towers are installed, the company must ensure no uncontrolled fuel spillage and must apply for any relevant small-scale emission registration under local regulations, although zero VOC or dust emissions are expected from pure drafting activities.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety and firefighting clearance is required for the office premises in accordance with the Law on Fire Prevention and Fighting of 2021 and Decree No. 136/2020/ND-CP; the landlord or building manager should evidence the valid Fire Safety Certificate for the building, and the company must maintain fire extinguishers, escape signage, evacuation procedures, and staff fire safety training if the building is classified under the statutory fire prevention list. Occupational safety clearance is governed by the Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH13: the company must perform a workplace risk assessment, issue safety procedures for computer-based work, ensure ergonomic workstations, and contract a licensed occupational health service for periodic health checks. Structural load certification is a building owner obligation; the tenant company should obtain a copy of the building's issuance certificate and occupations permit. Civil defence registration is not a standalone licence for a leased office in an existing permitted building.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế) under the Ministry of Finance of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Official portals: Electronic Tax Portal (https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn); National Electronic Invoice Portal (https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn); Electronic Portal for Foreign Suppliers (https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn); National Business Registration Portal (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vietnam operates a unified TIN/VAT-ID system (Mã số thuế, MST). The standard SOP is: (1) obtain an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) from the provincial Department of Planning and Investment or the relevant Export Processing/Industrial Zone Authority; (2) file for the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) on the National Business Registration Portal; the GDT automatically generates the MST, which is embedded in the ERC and serves concurrently as the tax identification number for CIT, VAT, PIT withholding and foreign-contractor tax returns of the LLC — no separate paper TIN certificate needs to be collected; (3) complete post-registration e-tax formalities: activate the business profile at the competent local Tax Sub-Department, register the electronic tax transaction and payment account on https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn, purchase an accredited digital signature (USB token), and file the e-invoice registration on the National Electronic Invoice Portal; (4) register the LLC's legal-branch/office and bank account details in the national database; (5) if a foreign parent or offshore contractor sells digital/B2C services into Vietnam without a PE, that foreign entity separately registers under the Foreign Contractor Withholding Tax or via the etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn portal — the VN LLC itself does not obtain a separate VAT certificate beyond the MST.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the foreign-invested LLC is a Vietnamese resident enterprise, taxed at entity level on its worldwide CIT income (standard 20% headrate); it is NOT a fiscally transparent or pass-through vehicle and no taxpayer election to be treated as a disregarded entity exists. The territorial scope is a worldwide-residency base: the enterprise's offshore engineering/BIM/CAD export turnover is taxable CIT income in Vietnam (subject to DTT exemptions and the 0% VAT export regime where applicable). EPE/software/export-service tax incentives may reduce effective CIT rates but do not alter the entity-level classification.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vietnam does not provide check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election mechanisms for entity classification. Statutory options available to the LLC include: (i) election between VAT credit/refund method and the direct method of VAT calculation where eligible; (ii) application of preferential CIT/incentive regimes (e.g., EPE status, software-product enterprise, high-technology enterprise) through licensing rather than tax-form election; (iii) under the DTT, election to apply PE-threshold analysis and claim treaty relief/benefits via MAP and APA procedures with the GDT's Treaty Division; (iv) for non-resident service providers acceding as subcontractors, the optional application of the Foreign Contractor Withholding Tax regime under Circular 80/2021/TT-BTC; (v) grouping of related-party documentation under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP with no one-way-up election permitted; and (vi) an election for filing/accounting year calendar-year alignment. No unlimited loss carry-forward election: CIT losses can be carried forward continuously up to five years only.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT — thuế giá trị gia tăng/GTGT), a multi-stage credit-method destination VAT administered under the Law on VAT (Law 13/2008/QH12, consolidated and revised, as amended by Law 48/2024/QH15 effective 1 July 2025) and implementing Decrees 209/2013/ND-CP and 219/2013/TT-BTC.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Corporations/LLCs are mandatorily VAT-registered upon incorporation; no annual revenue threshold applies to a company as legal person. The VND 100,000,000 per annum economic threshold is relevant only to individuals/household businesses opting out of full VAT registration. Foreign digital suppliers or foreign contractors without a PE in Vietnam have no turnover exemption threshold and must register on the GDT's electronic foreign supplier portal (etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn) irrespective of local revenue, provided the supply is made to Vietnamese customers (B2C domestic consumption).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT- and CIT-relevant invoices must be e-invoices under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC in XML format, with the mandatory fiscal QR code and the supplier's digital signature. For high-risk classes, the enterprise applies an 'invoice with tax authority code' where the GDT's portal pre-numbers and digitally clears the invoice in real time; for standard enterprise issuance (no tax code), the invoice is generated locally and the data file (XML) must be transferred to the National Electronic Invoice Portal (https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn) immediately at issuance (technically near real-time API submission), after which the GDT assigns the invoice serial number confirmation; export zero-rated invoices are also transmitted through the same portal. There is no physical wet-ink stamping; the QR code serves as the fiscal stamp/clearance marker. POS-linked fiscal devices require real-time data streaming to the tax authority. The LLC must maintain its invoice-books ledger (account 5113/3331) reconciled to the portal registers.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero percent VAT on exported services (Article 9 of the VAT framework and Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC) is available to the LLC where: (1) the service (offshore BIM, structural CAD/drafting, engineering design) is supplied to a foreign organization or individual; (2) the foreign customer has no permanent establishment in Vietnam with respect to the transaction; (3) the service is consumed entirely outside Vietnam and the output/data are used abroad; (4) the sales contract is written and signed with the foreign counterparty; (5) payment is received in a freely convertible foreign currency from an account abroad and is remitted into the LLC's Vietnamese bank account, evidenced by an inward remittance certificate / SWIFT; and (6) the LLC retains a complete export dossier comprising the contract, 0% e-invoice, delivery/production acceptance report, proof of offshore use, and bank documentation. Services expressly excluded from zero-rating (e.g., shipping brokerage, reinsurance/brokerage, training, domestic-consumption services) are not covered; those remain 10% taxable.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic customs declaration E-5/Form HQ/2015/EXP) — applicable only when physical design kits, drawings, or hardware prototypes are exported; for a pure service export no physical customs declaration is filed and this item is substituted by the service delivery certificate

Bill of Lading / Air Waybill — applicable only when tangible goods/samples are shipped; for BIM/CAD service deliverables substitute a signed service acceptance and handover certificate (biên bản bàn giao) evidencing offshore consumption

Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) from the LLC's Vietnamese licensed bank, or the SWIFT MT103/FX evidence, confirming that the foreign buyer's payment in a freely convertible currency was received from an offshore account
Written offshore service contract entered with the non-resident client, defining the BIM/CAD scope and territorial consumption
Zero-rated VAT e-invoice (0%) issued to the foreign client in compliance with Decree 123/2020/ND-CP

Supporting export-compliance file: delivery logs, IP handover data, transfer records, foreign client's confirmation of the off-shore use, and the LLC's VAT/CIT ledgers demonstrating the export turnover and input VAT reconciliation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The GDT may audit export zero-rating claims for up to five years (and longer for transfer-pricing/related-party issues). Where an export VAT application fails the statutory test, the tax authority recharacterizes the revenue to the standard 10% VAT rate, issues an additional VAT assessment, claws back any input VAT already refunded or offset, and charges late-payment interest at 0.03% per day (per Article 59 of Law 38/2019/QH12). Administrative sanctions under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP include fines up to three times the evaded tax amount (with organizational maximums set by the decree) and forfeiture of refund entitlements; false invoicing/electronic data manipulation can trigger criminal tax-evasion liability under Article 200 of the Penal Code 2015, with penalties up to 7 years' imprisonment and fines up to 4.5 times the evaded tax where the evaded amount exceeds the statutory criminal threshold. The LLC's legal representative and chief accountant may bear personal liability for signed false declarations.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV; Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam), operating under the Foreign Exchange Ordinance No. 05/2005/PL-UBTVQH11, as amended, together with implementing decrees and SBV circulars regulating foreign exchange, banking, and current/capital account activities.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Viet Nam operates a split current/capital account regime. The current account is fully convertible for bona fide trade in services: a resident LLC billing non-resident clients for CAD/BIM engineering work may receipt foreign currency without prior SBV licensing, provided (i) the underlying Master Service Agreement and delivery acceptance are on file, (ii) the proceeds are remitted to an account at a licensed Vietnamese bank within the statutory 180-day repatriation window, and (iii) the servicing bank captures the transaction under its balance-of-payments reporting. The capital account, by contrast, remains controlled: inbound FDI equity and shareholder loans require an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), charter capital contribution schedule, a dedicated Foreign Investment Capital Account (FICA) issued by the licensed bank, and, for loans, SBV ex-ante registration; outbound remittances of dividends, royalties, and liquidation proceeds require audited Vietnamese financial statements, tax finalization certificates, and board resolutions. Non-resident direct ownership in the LLC is freely permitted with no minimum capital floor under Viet Nam's enterprise regime, but all fund flows must pass through a domestically licensed credit or payment institution; offshore-digital EMI rails are not a recognized channel for satisfying statutory receipt-repatriation rules.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no mandatory conversion ('surrender') ratio applicable to the LLC's export service receipts. Under the 2005 Foreign Exchange Ordinance (as amended) and SBV implementing guidance, receipts from the export of engineering/BIM services must be repatriated to Viet Nam and credited to a FX demand-deposit account (or export proceeds account) at a licensed credit institution within 180 days following the completion of services or issuance of the corresponding invoice, whichever is earlier. A licensed bank may grant a single extension of up to 30 additional days upon verified documentary justification. The LLC may retain 100% of USD receipts in the account without forced sale to VND; conversion to VND for payroll and local operating expenses is voluntary and executed at the onshore prevailing market rate agreed with the bank. The bank is obliged to report any overdue receipt and any failure to repatriate to the SBV as a foreign exchange infringement, exposing the LLC to penalties between VND 80,000,000 and VND 100,000,000 plus possible suspension of the bank authorization.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium feasibility as a primary rail. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Currencycloud) are not licensed credit institutions or authorized payment-service settlement providers under the SBV's payment or FX regime; they cannot open a statutory FICA and cannot give the LLC the documentary 'licensed bank credit' that satisfies export-proceeds repatriation compliance. Their permitted use is limited to an ancillary collection and aggregation layer for small-value trial invoices, subject to the mandatory condition that all EMI balances are swept to the LLC's licensed VN bank account no later than the 180-day window; the LLC then must present EMI statements as reconciliation evidence in the bank's annual due-diligence review. Any pattern of lingering offshore balances or direct client-to-EMI billing without a corresponding onshore licensed-bank credit will be treated by the servicing bank as a foreign-exchange breach and trigger remedial KYC intervention.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory. At least one registered legal representative (typically the General Director or the Chairman of the LLC) must appear in person at the Vietnamese licensed bank branch to execute account-opening forms, undergo identity verification, and activate the corporate internet-banking credentials. Remote/video interview is accepted as supplementary KYC for second legal representatives, beneficial owners, and signatories, but cannot replace the statutory in-branch authentication for a foreign-invested entity. A non-resident director may delegate the in-branch appearance through a Vietnamese-resident officer holding a notarized and consular-legalized power of attorney, provided the original POA is lodged with the bank and a certified translation into Vietnamese is produced.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore legal representative resident in, or tax-transparent corporate ownership from, a jurisdiction the bank classifies as high-risk (e.g., jurisdictions on FATF black/grey lists or with opaque registry disclosure).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Consular-legalized certified passport copy; 12-month reference letter from a fully regulated home-jurisdiction bank; independent professional CV of the director evidencing genuine operational role; corporate register extract confirming the non-resident parent's active status; AML Source-of-Wealth declaration supported by audited group financial statements; and beneficial-ownership chart with all intermediate entities included.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Intangible-service export profile (CAD/BIM structural drafting and consulting) with no physical goods flow, generating recurring monthly cross-border USD receipts that underwriting may misread as potential 'shell' or pass-through activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed Master Service Agreement with the foreign end-client; per-project work orders and invoices; BIM deliverable acceptance and sign-off certificates or model-issue logs; project management platform screenshots evidencing employee labor; monthly salary/payroll reports to the VN tax office; the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) and Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) evidencing the LLC's actual establishment; and ISIC 7110 scope statement in the business registration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment pattern showing material third-party payers whose remitting entity name does not appear in the client contract, or repeated same-day split wires into and out of the operational account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Payment-flow reconciliation schedule mapping each MT103 sender to its contractual role; group payment delegation letters from the contracting client identifying the paying affiliate; assignment or onboarding addenda; invoice-level reconciliation between time sheets, invoices, and bank credits; and a sworn written explanation of any multi-payer consolidation arrangement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large one-off inbound FDI capital injection or shareholder loan that falls outside the ordinary service-revenue pattern and triggers enhanced-source-of-funds scrutiny.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SBV-registered IRC and charter capital contribution schedule; parent company board resolution approving the injection; share-sale/contribution agreement; source-of-funds statement supported by the parent's audited accounts and bank confirmation; SBV registration certificate for any shareholder loan (under Circular 12/2022/TT-NHNN framework); and confirmation that the funds were credited exclusively to the FICA before any operating disbursement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of offshore EMI rails (Wise/Airwallex) visible in the LLC's banking history, triggering suspicion of unrepatriated export proceeds or unlicensed inward payment settlement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sworn undertaking designating the licensed VN bank account as the sole residual settlement account; monthly EMI transaction statements demonstrating a sweep-and-settle to the licensed bank within the statutory 180-day window; FX reconciliation report aligned with invoice dates; and the bank's written record that no EMI balance has been retained offshore for more than 30 days post-delivery.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Initial and subsequent FDI equity contributions must be routed exclusively by SWIFT MT103 from the offshore parent to the LLC's Foreign Investment Capital Account (FICA) at the licensed Vietnamese bank, using the balance-of-payments purpose code for inward FDI equity capital (approximately code 101a under the SBV international-transaction classification), with the remittance reference quoting the IRC registration number and the charter capital installment number. The servicing bank verifies the credit against the approved IRC and capital-contribution schedule; the FICA funds are then converted or disbursed into the operational VND account only after the bank has sighted the lawful source documentation (MT103 allocation and contributor identity). Any shareholder loan requires SBV ex-ante registration through the servicing bank before remittance and must be contracted at arm's-length interest under Decree 68/2016/ND-CP (transfer pricing) frameworks; loan drawdowns are separately coded and cannot be commingled with equity injections.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Service-trade outflows (subcontract design fees, software licenses, royalties, and permitted profit repatriation) are cleared by standard SWIFT MT103/telegraphic transfers through the LLC's licensed bank international desk, supported by (i) the underlying service or licensing contract, (ii) Vietnamese tax receipts evidencing withholding (CIT and Foreign Contractor Tax) where applicable, and (iii) a board resolution capturing dividend or payment approval. Profit/retained-earnings repatriations require completion of the statutory annual independent audit, filing of the audited financial statements and tax finalization to the General Department of Taxation, and the bank's verification of net-after-tax distributable profits; the LLC then remits in convertible currency with the BOP code for repatriation of investment profits. Commercial Letters of Credit are structurally unnecessary for CAD/BIM services, but where a foreign client insists on a documentary rail, the LLC may accept a Standby or Confirmed LC; proceeds so received are treated as export service receipts and remain subject to the identical 180-day repatriation and KYC verification protocol.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward contracts (outright forwards) with a licensed Vietnamese credit institution, executed only against a genuine underlying service-export or dividend-repatriation transaction, with tenors capped at 365 days under SBV Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN (as amended by Circular 20/2018/TT-NHNN); the bank must retain copies of the underlying contract and invoice.

FX swap contracts (same-currency or cross-currency principal exchange) executed bilaterally with the licensed bank to convert USD earnings into VND for operating purposes and re-convert at a future fixed rate, supported by the same underlying transaction documentation.

Currency options (call/put) where offered by the licensed bank as structural hedging for capital-account exposures such as FICA conversion or shareholder-loan repayment; the option premium and notional must be derived from the registered loan or contribution schedule.

Natural hedging via staggered multi-currency invoicing (USD and EUR tranches) and disciplined timing of outflows within the 180-day repatriation window, plus an offshore parent-level NDF on VND used purely as a portfolio hedge; onshore NDFs are not recognized and SBV-licensed banks will not book them for a VN resident entity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements (Báo cáo tài chính năm) submitted via the electronic tax portal and delivered in hard copy to the tax office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department (Cục Thuế) of the enterprise's registered address; copy to the Department of Planning and Investment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the 90th day after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year LLC, by 31 March of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late submission penalties under Decree 41/2018/ND-CP (as amended): VND 5–10 million for 1–6 months late, VND 10–20 million for 6–12 months late, VND 20–30 million for 12 months or more; failure to file for two consecutive years may lead to administrative strike-off of the Enterprise Registration Certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax (CIT) finalization return (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN) with audited financial statements attached
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department (Cục Thuế) supervising the LLC's tax identification number
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 calendar days after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year LLC, by 31 March of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP: VND 2–5 million (1–30 days), VND 8–15 million (60–90 days), VND 15–30 million (more than 90 days), plus 0.03% daily interest on any unpaid CIT; chronic non-filing exposes the LLC to tax audit and distraint.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual enterprise report (Báo cáo thường niên) and updates to the National Business Registration Database
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) / National Business Registration Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the 90th day after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year LLC, by 31 March of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of VND 10–20 million for late or false reporting (Decree 50/2016/ND-CP); non-filing for 12 consecutive months supports revocation of the business registration certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual license fee (lệ phí môn bài) declaration and full payment covering the new calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Tax Sub-Department (Chi cục Thuế) of the head office district
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Declaration and payment due by 31 January of each operating calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late declaration fines apply under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP; unpaid fee accrues interest at 0.03% per day and the tax authority may distrain bank accounts or enforce collection against the LLC's assets.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory annual independent audit for every foreign-invested enterprise (FIE) in Vietnam, regardless of revenue or asset size, under Article 15 of Decree 174/2016/ND-CP; the audit must be performed by a certified Vietnamese auditing firm and the audited statements must accompany the annual CIT finalization return.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) and Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC; Law on Accounting No. 88/2015/QH13; foreign-currency conversion recorded per Circular 53/2016/TT-NHNN; IFRS is not compulsory for a private LLC unless it later becomes a public-interest entity.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam does not impose a standalone annual UBO confirmation return on a private engineering LLC; in lieu of it, the LLC must maintain the statutory member register (Sổ đăng ký thành viên) at the head office, update it within 10 days after any change of members or capital, and notify the DPI through the National Business Registration Portal; changes involving a foreign investor must also be reflected in the annual investment project report filed with the DPI.
